{{Quote| The other apparent legacy of a Celestial connection is pyramid-building. The Kwa built them. So did the Sharu. And many others.|[[Insmot Bowen]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-the-celestials|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut &mdash; The Celestials|int=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut}}</ref>}}
A '''pyramid''' was a structure where the upper surfaces were of triangular shape and converged on one point. Pyramids could be found on several [[Planet/Legends|planets]], including plastic ones on [[Rafa V]] and [[Pyramid One]] on [[Ahakista/Legends|Ahakista]]. [[Tandun III]] also possessed pyramids.

The geometric shape of the pyramid was revered by the Sith.<ref name="Trail">From the narration of [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's]] thoughts in ''[[Jedi Quest: The Trail of the Jedi]]''.</ref>
